label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

SHE DID IT!!! 🎉🎉🎉 My best friend @Lorna Villaruz got her NMC PIN today!!! I am so happy I can't even type properly, I keep making mistakes and my hands are shaking haha. Officially a registered nurse in the UK!!! 🙏❤️

For those who don't know Lorna, we trained together in nursing school in Iloilo. Capping ceremony 1996, same hairstyle, same dream (you saw the throwback photo she posted, don't laugh 😂). In our dorm we polished our white shoes every single night, and every single night she borrowed my polish. 4 years and she never bought her own, lol. Lorna I am still waiting for you to pay me back for that polish, I will accept dried mangoes 😂

Then life took us different ways. She went to Riyadh, then Dubai, almost 18 years working there. Me, I came to the UK in 2004. I still remember her at the airport crying, crying, and she said to me "susunod ako," I will follow you. And for 20 years I have been telling her come na, come to Liverpool, what are you waiting for!! 22 years later... she is finally following me haha. Better late than never, ha, bes? 😂

She did her OSCE in Nottingham, and I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into. No surprises, I told her the truth from the start 🌧️☔

She lands in Manchester on 14 January, and she starts on 25 January on Ward 7 😭😭 I will be the one at arrivals crying this time, and probably holding a sign like a mad woman. Ward 7, you are so lucky. Lorna is the best nurse I know. Calm, always calm, even when everything is going crazy around her, and the patients love her. Wherever she goes, the patients ask for her by name. You will see.

She is staying with us for her first month in our spare room (Ben says ok, thank you mahal 😘). Don't worry bes, the room is ready, I will put a heater and a thick duvet because I know you will freeze. You are coming from Dubai to Liverpool in January, Lord help you 😂 PLEASE bring a proper coat, the Liverpool wind is no joke. Not the cute one for the photo, a PROPER one. If not, we go to Primark straight from the airport, I'm serious. I will also show you the 14 bus to town and get you a sim card. Everything, don't worry, I have a list already haha.

And to our Filipino family here in Merseyside, please welcome my sister from another mother!! Lorna, you are not alone here, you have a whole family waiting for you. Christmas parties with too much pancit, potlucks, raffle tickets, the karaoke that goes until the neighbours complain 😂 And next Christmas, Simbang Gabi with us at St Teresa's, all nine nights, you and me and Ben, just like back home. I'm already so excited for it.

Lorna, I am so so proud of you. You worked so hard for this. Thank you Lord for answering our prayers, and for bringing my best friend to me after all these years 🙏

Welcome to Liverpool, bes. Welcome home ❤️🇵🇭🇬🇧

#susunodako #finally #Liverpool #NMCPIN #BestFriendsForever

---

A few notes, Charing:
- I left out the OSCE resit and the agency loan because she asked you to keep those private in her message. The Nottingham OSCE is only mentioned as the place she did it, with the rain photo.
- I put the dates of her landing and first day but not the exact flight time or the hospital name. That's a bit safer for a public post. You can add them if you want.
- The Christmas party on 12 December and Simbang Gabi from 16 December are both before she arrives, so I wrote "next Christmas" so it doesn't sound like she's coming this year.

Congratulations to you both!! 🎉
